title: lineage-manifest.v1
description: Per-run metadata emitted to /tmp/lineage-extract-static-<session>/manifest.json at the end of every lineage-extract-static run. Captures provenance, costs, counters, and error log for auditability. Validated against this schema before the run terminates.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run. Format: 'lineage-<unix_epoch>-<8-hex-rand>'.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project being scanned.

workspace_tree_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted '<repo-rel-path>:<file-sha256>\n' lines of in-scope files. Mirrors mypy incremental cache key. Same workspace + same prompts + same model = same cache hit.

files_scanned.description: Count of in-scope files actually analyzed (not skipped). Includes cache hits.

total_chunks.description: Sum of chunk_count across all in-scope files. Equal to files_scanned for inline-only runs.

total_edges_emitted.description: Total edges across the openlineage.ndjson stream.

duration_seconds.description: Total wall-clock duration of the run.

llm_token_cost_estimate_usd.description: OPTIONAL estimated cost. Calculated as token count * model_pricing[model_id] when the in-session CLI exposes token counts; absent otherwise.

prompt_template_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical concatenation of all prompts/*.md files at scan time. Invalidates cache when prompts change.

model_id.description: Specific model id used by the in-session AI CLI (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-5.4', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Locks the cache to a model generation.

redaction_count.description: OPTIONAL count of redactions applied by redact.py across all rollups. Surfaced for audit.

cache_hit_rate.description: OPTIONAL ratio of cache-hit files to total files. 1.0 = warm rerun. Absent when cache is disabled.

exit_status.description: OPTIONAL final exit status. SUCCESS = all files processed cleanly. PARTIAL = some files skipped or some non-fatal errors. FAILED = fail-closed abort (redaction error, validation error).

business.description: OPTIONAL project-level business block (S59 business-analysis pass, design §3.1). Assembled by merge_into_ol.assemble_manifest_business — sections omitted when the source gave nothing; domains partition only objects present in the bundle (single primary domain per member). Consumed by the DLP OL importer's report builder.
